<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission and Legal Challenges:</strong> The Election Commission has proposed 42 tribunals to address a backlog of 3.7 million appeals in West Bengal, while Mamata Banerjee has moved the Supreme Court to challenge the freezing of the Trinamool Congress name and symbol.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQUWhUVVo2VGp2MnpJS013cU9lMUt2NTMySFJoRU9vOGlHLUFNUGotWmRtbjlaajR4UWFicnBaTEFNdW1UM1cxUnFLRW5BaE8tQnItaHJNUnVPV1UxaFltSnNLTjlNa19pUTlieE9WdDg1emUxeFY2MzZsT01sYy16MjJkNzE0dExDZmo4UnhQcmdDMlUxaDVRaEd4VmNNSE9XSVc3ZndsMkplY1FqZktaaUtjN1VobFFSaThWbXJHQ2w?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxNVTEwSEY0aUlQc3pzb19VODc0eFdqM0lQM2U3S0NWNVVPc3Iyc243d2ZreWVPTE5xNVdjaThLR1JfRWNnWDFibTlJUGRxXzN5eU1Eb1I2eUU3bmtQWUdUNW1nNDA0VFlSMGVVT2xseEJxMUgwNDlteUlYdGRuQnpfdm94ckItRjc5NEk3bjdBZXVwbkk?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNM1laSkJYRERKcUVTZUttVDJWa2ljX3p1ZXZvbmQtc2Y5LVRxcExLd1Y4eG9lUGl4SEhkaUpjLVZwMndoUHQxcGRadWowWURZcEVVMl9oQlRuV0RyWkk4WlBQT29NbXVpYmpOVjVmMVQ2dU5JVDVBelI2azFsbmFJX09sVUNvdzdPT2RhbmdjMW5udlZuTDdQVHBZTHVjRjA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Public Procurement Reform:</strong> The Union Cabinet has approved a draft Public Procurement Ordinance aimed at enhancing market competition and modernizing the government&#x27;s purchasing processes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxNREoyVXlNSW5KTDYtc1RRRC0zVV9nelM0SkZwcGpLYnJxdEF0b3VybDlSNDlxTlJSOGR2UTl3VTFjTGNBbW10cnE4WEFsbkxKUERLY0pySmJEUHJFY2RJNHdlVHV0SkV6dGV6U3IzR0dJT2x4U0VONExYcjhtd09YN2FiS0R3T0hOYU9RbkVFbVBFTkNOYjFWMHBJbElJRUd6ZDF3bDk2ZGNwQWFTdHlhMzVZal9XOHF4VnNadHdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>SIR Notices and Political Scrutiny:</strong> High-profile figures, including Election Commissioner SS Sandhu, former Supreme Court judge Ranjana Desai, and veteran leader LK Advani, have received notices under the Delhi SIR, sparking political reactions from opposition leaders.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>International Representation:</strong> Nila Vikhe Patil, the niece of a Maharashtra BJP minister, has been elected to the Swedish Parliament, marking a notable instance of Indian-origin political success abroad.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
</ul>
